author: ClemVKG
quote:
I dont understand what I am playing. I have played 15 hours. Half of the missions are "go do this for the torta, go do that for the torta". I dont get where is the fun in that. 
Every GTA game is very different from the last. I was not even expecting a GTA5 goofy unhinged story in this one. But GTA6 story and writting are GENUINLY BAD. I dont know who wrote the characters and the story, but this is 2024 AI slop level of bad. Lucia is unsufferable. Everything that happens to her and to everyone around her is her fault, and she acts as this entitled brat that deserves love and success. And I feel like the game is forcing me to like that and to support her.

 This was the last time I gave Rockstar my money. I bought ALL the rockstar game up to now. You guys probably made more than a 1000 dollar off of me, on games and onlines, and you wont anymore. Congrats. 

To ANY PC player reading this ahead of the PC release : Dont buy it. Not worth it. DOnt spend your money to play that game, and dont reward Rockstar and Take Two for destroying the licence you have learned to love.

author: ClemVKG
quote:

I am constanlty facing player of the same level that have all the versatility in the world to face their opponants, having access to class swaps I dont, that are quite badly balanced ( the indestructible shield is one of em). 

NO TEAM DEATH MATCH 
OVERLY RELIANT ON CHAMPION ABILITY
MAP DESIGN IS HEAVILY ORIENTED TOWARD SNIPER ( I never play sniper in any fps, because I generally prefer running around killing and dying a lot, but here was able to get from 0 to 40 kills a game with the base sniper. Itsridiculously OP) so it takes the fun out of the other weapon classes. Shotgun is relevant only on a couple of maps. LMGS are way too slow and underpowered ( at full spray, you kill someone faster with an SMG which makes no sense at all)

All in All this game is designed to be a cash cow for the one of the top 3 worst video game company of all time : Ubisoft (Yasuke was not a Samurai)

author: ClemVKG
quote:
No bugs, nice nelevl design, good depth for the fight system, and of course, the legendary Naheulbeuk universe, deveopped 20 years by Pen of Chaos.
Artistic direction is really nice, same for musics and dialogue. The story is hilarious and compelling, the jokes are good, and there are hundreds of small references to loveraft, tolkien, and other famous fantasy/fiction master piece.

Dont let yourself get scared of by a few bad reviews from people with a toaster for a computer. The game runs fine, and better than the average release this days. The couple of "professional" critic that have review this game to give it average grades are often offended by the humour this game has. You probably know how it is in 2020, people will get offended for no reason.

Keep in mind that this game is a great work, made by a small team of pasionate nerds and role play gamer over the course of quite a few years. It aint, perfect, but its damn refreshing. Dont hasitate two second to get it.

author: ClemVKG
quote:
If you dont care about details, or if you are not here to read a lonnng review, just read those first lines to understand why so many people hate that sequel:

In short, character developpement is catastrophic, plot justification are lacking, and for more than anything, the gameplay has barely evolved. The first one was so much better, in many sense.
More than the weird feeling you get when the character you learned to love are displaying unfitting behaviors, its the general atmosphere of the game that failed to make feel attached to it.

Storytelling is such an important part of how a game or a movie touches its audience, yet it seems to have been completely forgotten here. The character writing especially is somehow downgraded exponentially from the first opus, with potent character being written off like they got discarded at a casting, while other "new" empty character got a surprising amount of spotlight (not the good kind of surprise). This resulted in a most of the storylines and quests being meaningless and unexciting. And since this is supposed to be the heart of the game, that why I cannot give it a decent grade.

I dont even care that the gameplay is just a loop of repetitive similar challenges and situation, for which you get bored after a couple of hours. Thats not even the point.
The point is that a story telling game got so lost in social virtue that its own soty telling has been killed. I was looking forward for that game so much and end up givin this kind of review only a day after release. This game will stay an example of how incerting politics and social issues into games can destroy good story telling, and divide its fanbase.
game_title: The Last of Us Part II

author: ClemVKG
quote:
How to say this...
So much potential in the Far Cry licence, and they give us that.
What is good about the game:
-Graphics and optimisation.
-Music
-Well built map

What is wrong about the game.
Almost everything. The fact that now Far cry is a stat shooter ( yes, a headshot with a gun does not kill most ennemies anymore) kils the gameplay and the fun. It means that there are ennemies you virtually cannot kill at the beginning of the game.
The story is just not there. There is nothing exciting, no twist, no charismatic antagonist (yes joseph is here but for like 5 minute tops) and its horribly short. The replayability is bad. You will finished the game on difficult at 100% in around 11-12 hours. By then you'll have maxed out weapon, perks, and vehicule that will take all the challenge away.

The politicaly correct. You feel it through the whole game. Those two twins are empty. They are  here because Ubisoft wanted to fullfil a checklissst in their political agenda. They are here because they are black and female, and because the devs wanted you to understand that "ThOsE ArE StRoNg AnTaGoNiSt"

It is not a good game. It is a politicaly correct skin of Far Cry 5, with a fration of the fun, a fration of the immersion and people are right to hate it.

author: ClemVKG
quote:
I have to put a bad grade on this one. The simple reason is the solo mode. A lot of player are going to play this game for its solo features. And let me tell you that the "story mode" as it calls himself, is a living cancer.

It is a cancer because of the AI in this game. Never you'll see a AI so broken. As you as you crank up the difficulty , the AI is simply perfect. And I mean PERFECT. It wont miss a shoot, wont miss a combo, wont let you deal any damage, it has the level of a hall of fame smash player, and the only way you'll beat certain "spirit" is with patience to try again 156 times, and a huge amount of luck. Because in the story mode, the fights are not fair. You have handicaps, and they have advantages.

On top of that, the story mode does not have a story. At all. Its a chain of fights, without cut scene, without interest, without anything special. When you see the fantastic work done for the scenario on Smash Bros Brawl, you realise that this smash, no matter how good can the rest be, is only here to make **** loads of money.
